source_changes.finding: Latest main removes ppo_runner.py and train_ppo.py. The remaining supermimic_runner.py keeps world-model plus policy training, but changes reset sampling and policy-update inputs.
Latest main removes motion_tracking_env.py and multi_task_world_model_env.py. WorldModelEnv now takes an mjlab wrapper and TaskSpec list, exposes sample_start, and returns three step outputs.
Dynamics and BPTT actor rollouts use CUDA bfloat16 autocast. The collection path no longer adds the previous policy action noise.
Target linear and angular velocities are rotated into the predicted root heading before velocity tracking terms are scored.
Latest lock resolves mjlab 1.6.0, MuJoCo-Warp 4.0.1, rsl-rl-lib 5.5.2, Torch 2.15.0, Warp >=1.15 and viser 1.1.1.
The matching mjlab main also moved to 379c55e8 with a large API and asset update. This review branch leaves the checked-in sibling at dd51a9fc, so it is not claimed as a runnable current-main pair.

compatibility_decision.reason: Changing the runner, reward velocity frame, action noise and dependency stack would invalidate the matched timing protocol. Existing four-H100 scores remain bound to source commit 7f394693eba91056120be3fcfe7605dbabd6c9f1.
